_comment5: For B1 accuracy testing — one entry per trial.
images_dir: folder of frames captured during that trial (the camera images).
ground_truth_present: matric numbers of enrolled students physically present.
unregistered_present: matric numbers of people in the room who are NOT enrolled.
Trials now use REAL phone-captured frames via camera_simulator.html + --capture,
sampled from today's pending_capture_2 (bright daylight) and pending_capture_3
(fluorescent) batches — not stock photos. trial_3 is a shuffled mix of both,
standing in for 'mixed light'. No unregistered person in this data — all 4
were present in all captures, per today's real PDF reports.
Expanded 2026-08-30 with previously-unused frames from the same two batches
(trial_1/2/3 now 15/18/14 images, up from 10/10/10) — all 4 still ground
truth-present in every added frame, no new config needed for this trial set.
Each trial's 10 images are also split into 3 SIMULATED distance buckets
(filenames tagged _far/_mid/_near): _far is untouched; _mid is a centered
75%-width crop upscaled back to full size (mimics closer/narrower framing);
_near is a tighter 55% crop, same technique. This simulates distance via
digital zoom on the SAME photos — it does not reproduce the actual optical
softness a genuinely-farther shot would have, so treat this as a framing
test (does recognition hold up as the face occupies less of the frame),
not a true optical-distance test.
